subject: science
title: Weather Words
about: The weather words a first grader hears every morning (sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, snowy, foggy), reading hot and cold on a thermometer, what to wear and carry, puddles and where they go, and that weather can change in one day. Weather is a kindergarten standard in NC's 2023 science standards, so this is a bridge deck filed under ESS.1.1.1 (sun and sky patterns), the closest Grade 1 objective.
tip: Make him the weather reporter at breakfast: he looks out the window, says the weather word and picks what to wear.

cards.q: The sky is clear and bright and the sun is out. What kind of day is it?
cards.note: A sunny day is a good day to look for your shadow.

cards.q: Gray clouds cover the whole sky. What kind of day is it?
cards.note: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water floating in the air.

cards.q: Drops of water fall from the clouds. What is the weather?
cards.note: Rain gives plants, animals and people the water they need.

cards.q: The trees bend and leaves fly around. What kind of day is it?
cards.note: Wind is moving air. You cannot see it, but you can feel it and see what it pushes.

cards.q: Soft white flakes fall and cover the ground. What is the weather?
cards.note: Snow is frozen water. It falls when the air is very cold.

cards.q: A low cloud sits on the ground and you can hardly see across the street. What is that?
cards.note: Fog is a cloud down at the ground. It often comes in the early morning.
When the drops in a cloud get big and heavy, they fall as rain.

cards.q: It rained all morning. What is left on the sidewalk?
cards.note: A puddle is rain water that has not soaked in or dried up yet.

cards.q: The sun comes out and the puddle gets smaller. Where did the water go?
cards.note: The sun's heat dries up puddles. We say the water evaporates.

cards.q: The red line in the thermometer is way up high. Is it hot or cold outside?
cards.note: A thermometer measures temperature. High line, hot day.

cards.q: The red line in the thermometer is very low. Is it hot or cold outside?
cards.note: Low line, cold day. Water outside can freeze into ice.

cards.q: It is raining. What do you carry to stay dry?
cards.note: A raincoat keeps you dry too.

cards.q: What do you wear on your feet to keep them dry in puddles?
cards.note: Rain boots keep your socks dry.

cards.q: It is hot and sunny. What do you wear to keep the bright sun out of your eyes?
cards.note: A sun hat helps too. Never look right at the sun.

cards.q: It is snowing. What do you put on your hands?
cards.note: Mittens keep your fingers warm together in one pocket.

cards.q: Which toy flies best on a windy day?
cards.note: The wind pushes on the kite and holds it up.

cards.q: What do we call what the sky and air are like today, like sunny or rainy?
cards.note: Weather can change from day to day. Seasons change slowly.

cards.q: It was sunny this morning. Now it is raining. Can weather change in one day?
cards.note: That is why we look out the window every morning.
